timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹158.1 Cr (+28.9% YoY), net profit ₹4.07 Cr (against a loss of ₹0.88 Cr a year earlier).
Board of Bhagiradha Chemicals & Industries Limited recommended final dividend of Rs.0.15 per share (15%) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval on July 31, 2026.
Bhagiradha Chemicals released its investor presentation for Q4 & FY26, reporting revenue of ₹535.9 Cr and EBITDA of ₹57.1 Cr.
Bhagiradha Chemicals extended a ₹30 Cr corporate guarantee in favour of ICICI Bank for Rupee Term Loan to subsidiary Bheema Fine Chemicals.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at AGM
